g.title: reasoner/account_takeover/ — LoginEvent → AtoFeatureVector → ScorerOutput → build_observation(). The only domain-specific package; everything else is framework. Submits Observations and consumes EnforcementDecisions.
Inspects bundles, replays decisions, runs the eval gate.
OpenAI / Anthropic — policy-gate structured-output calls + LLM-as-judge calls.
POST /api/v1/decisions, GET /api/v1/decisions/{id}, POST .../replay. Hosts the in-process pipeline (app/decide.py) and shares connections via lifespan. app/main.py.
Generates synthetic LoginEvents across 8 scenarios (baseline_normal, credential_stuffing_burst, geo_impossible, post_breach_ato, …). generator/.
Trains the XGBoost scorer on heuristic-labelled archetypes; writes ato-v1.{ubj,json,train.csv,test.csv} into app/scorer/models/. app/scorer/trainer.py.
Reads corpus/**/*.md (frontmatter + body), chunks at ## boundaries, embeds with all-MiniLM-L6-v2, indexes into pgvector + Elasticsearch. app/retrieval/corpus_loader.py.
5-dimension governance gate (retrieval, faithfulness, consistency, citation, robustness). Runs in-process against the same pipeline the API uses. eval/runners/harness.py.
Sliding-window feature state (per-account hashes / sorted sets) and SHA-256 idempotency dedup keys. Redis 7.
Two roles in one cluster: HNSW vector store for the policy corpus (384-dim all-MiniLM-L6-v2) and append-only audit store for DecisionBundle JSONB. Postgres 16 + pgvector.
BM25 sparse index over policy chunks with dual-analyzer mapping for natural-language and exact regulatory identifiers. Elasticsearch 8.13.
